name: @frappe/frontend
comment: The framework's OWN declaration: the shared library set, pinned here and enforced by the build. `bench build` composes this with each contributing app's own dependencies into the generated package.json beside it, which is what yarn installs. One tree for all apps -- deliberately NOT a yarn workspace root, because workspaces hoist and nest on conflict rather than fail, and the charter wants hard failure at manifest assembly (#42069). `resolutions` pins vite because vitest declares its own wide range and yarn would otherwise nest a second copy: the tests would then transform modules with a different vite than the build uses, which is the one module graph this file exists to guarantee. vite is not one of manifest.py's six SINGLETONS -- those are the runtime libraries -- so nothing else would have caught it.
